author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: 4.6.4 fixes the Presence Report CSV export properly this time: 4.6.3's switch to decimal hours avoided the spreadsheet auto-reformatting problem but changed the format away from what was wanted. The CSV now keeps HH:MM text exactly as shown on the page, forced literal via a ="value" formula cell (the standard trick Excel/Sheets/Numbers all honour to stop them auto-typing a cell's content) - applied to both the hour columns and the Date column, since the same auto-detection was also showing dates as #### in a narrow column. 4.6.3 fixed the Decision detail table still wrapping text letter by letter on mobile after 4.6.1/4.6.2's fixes missed it (different CSS class, same overflow-wrap:anywhere root cause). 4.6.2 extended the Presence Report window from 30 to 90 days and added the CSV export. 4.6.1 fixed the default stale-evidence threshold (raised from 12 to 48 hours).
